findings.summary: The parameter encoding has no tag of its kind: Quality(Preview), Geometry(Rect), Fill(None) and Blend(Normal) all encode to 0x00, so content_key gives the same key for different parameters.
The domain byte b'R' and the node type bytes 1/2/3 are asserted against the crate's own constants, so the hand mutants that change them survive the whole suite.
1571 lines against a ~700 ceiling and a 480 forecast (2.34x the planning figure), with no recorded owner OK; the coordinator decides the split.
